facts.fact: On 6 February 2023 the Central African Republic inaugurated its national fibre backbone and its interconnection with the Republic of Congo (via Bomassa), part of the 935 km of installed and operational fibre under the AfDB and EU supported Central African Backbone project, with a Congolese telecoms ministry representative present; the release says this component completes the Cameroon and Congo components.
